answer_1.quote: In autoregressive generation tasks, given a sequence X = (x 1 , x 2 , ..., x T ) of length T , the model iteratively produces a probability distribution over the vocabulary for each position conditioned on preceding tokens.

answer_2.quote: We first present the model's perplexity on the validation set. Following previous work , we then evaluate the model's performance on downstream benchmarks, which includes zero-shot accuracy testing on Hellaswag , LAMBADA , SIQA , PIQA , StoryCloze , and Winogrande . Additionally, we conduct 5-shot evaluation measuring exact match performance on TriviaQA , WebQuestions (WebQs) , GSM8K , and Natural Questions (NaturalQs).
